title: Software universe classifier pilot axes record v0.2.0
description: Model-facing contract for the Item 1 software-universe gate. The model makes only two firm-level judgements, records confidence, and selects zero to three shared Item 1 block addresses. It cannot author quotations, retrieved text, offsets, digests, products, capabilities, tasks, or a tier. Those exclusions keep this gate separate from later PCT extraction.

passage_refs.description: MODEL-AUTHORED shared Item 1 block addresses. The pipeline retrieves their text, stable ids, raw-source byte offsets and digests.

allOf.description: A response that cites no Item 1 block may assert no conclusion.
A firm that does not offer a customer-facing digital product cannot be CORE or CO_ESSENTIAL on this gate.
